snippet.title: OLAPU | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3331590/OLAPU?utm_source=YouTube&utm_campaign=GameplayTrailer
^^ WISHLIST NOW ^^
Join our discord community: https://discord.com/invite/QEz59mjxPH

OLAPU is a fast-paced co-op action roguelite in which you and three other of your friends can team up to face escalating waves of enemies and massive raid-style bosses. Each run is a race to power up, survive and prove that you are worthy taking down the strongest entities in the realm.
